vectors.name: single-pair-short
vectors.notes: short book; worst ret +4.9%; IM = 49000000.

vectors.name: two-pair-hedged-exact-neutral
vectors.notes: identical return columns, opposite nets: every scenario loss exactly 0.

vectors.name: same-symbol-nets-to-zero
vectors.notes: netting collapses to zero exposure; IM 0.

vectors.name: near-delta-neutral-net-1
vectors.notes: net = 1 minor unit; exact IM = 1/20 minor unit; twin ceils to 1.

vectors.name: near-tie-1wei-at-cutoff
vectors.notes: K=200 m=2 (explicit); 2nd and 3rd sorted losses differ by 1 wei of return (exact loss gap = 1e6/1e18 minor units); scenario 2 misses the cutoff.

vectors.name: near-tie-1wei-k59-m28
vectors.notes: K=59 with table-carried m=28 (production shape; ceil(K/100) would say 1 -- wrong convention). 28 distinct top losses; scenario 28 sits exactly 1 wei of return below the m-th loss and misses the cutoff. IM = 8022000/28 = 286500.

vectors.name: exact-tie-index-tiebreak
vectors.notes: scenarios 3 and 7 identical worst loss; tie-break selects index 3; value unchanged either way -- pins selection determinism.

vectors.name: unlisted-fallback-mixed
vectors.notes: XAUUSD has no column: adds 0.433*2e8 = 86600000 to EVERY loss; IM = 50000000 + 86600000.

vectors.name: fallback-only-book-k59
vectors.notes: K=59 m=1; only held symbol unlisted; every loss = 0.433*1e8 = 43300000.

vectors.name: all-gains-clamp
vectors.notes: every scenario is a gain for the long book; raw ES = -1000000; clamp to 0, flagged.

vectors.name: all-gains-clamp-seat-floor
vectors.notes: clamped ES 0, seat floor 5000000 binds.

vectors.name: seat-floor-binding
vectors.notes: ES 50000000 < pushed 90000000; floor binds.

vectors.name: seat-floor-non-binding
vectors.notes: ES 50000000 > pushed 10000000; ES wins.

vectors.name: k300-divceil-mean
vectors.notes: K=300 m=3; net 1e9+1 makes every leg fractional; per-leg ceil adds 1 per scenario; twin = div_ceil(897000003, 3) = 299000001; exact mean = 299000000 + 299/1000.

vectors.name: m-equals-k-mean-of-all
vectors.notes: m = K = 5: ES degenerates to the mean of ALL scenario losses; IM = (1+2+3+4+5)*1e6/5 = 3000000.

vectors.name: m-convention-divergence-pin-m28-not-1
vectors.notes: K=100 with table-carried m=28. Correct IM = mean of worst 28 = (100+99+...+73)*1e6/28 = 86500000. A kernel deriving m=ceil(K/100)=1 would output 100000000 -- pinned so the wrong convention fails loudly.

vectors.name: max-notional-i128max
vectors.notes: net = i128::MAX; product 2^127 * ~2^59 exact, no overflow (U256 in kernel).

vectors.name: max-notional-i128min
vectors.notes: net = i128::MIN; |net| = 2^127 does NOT fit i128 -- kernel must use unsigned_abs into u128/U256.

vectors.name: empty-book
vectors.notes: no positions: all losses 0, IM 0, not flagged as clamped (0 is not < 0).

vectors.name: sparse-row-zero-fill
vectors.notes: BBB IS a column but omitted from even rows: omitted = return 0 that scenario, NOT fallback. Sparse == dense-zero. Worst loss = odd rows 5000000.

vectors.name: per-leg-rounding-pin
vectors.notes: THE rounding disambiguator: two legs of exact 0.5 each. Per-leg ceil -> 1+1 = 2. Accumulate-then-single-divide would give 1. Kernel must produce 2 to match.

vectors.name: mixed-sign-legs
vectors.notes: one loss leg (ceil) and one gain leg (floor) in the same scenario; twin = ceil(7770000.000000011) - floor(3330000.000000007) = 4440001.

vectors.name: k101-m2
vectors.notes: K=101, table-carried m=2; IM = (101+100)*1e6/2.

vectors.name: all-zero-returns
vectors.notes: all returns zero: IM 0, clamped flag false.

vectors.name: zero-net-listed-symbol
vectors.notes: AAA nets to zero: its huge -90% return contributes nothing; IM from BBB alone = 1e16*1e8/1e18 = 1000000.

vectors.name: zero-net-unlisted-no-fallback
vectors.notes: unlisted symbol netted flat: fallback * |0| = 0; identical to single-pair-long.

vectors.name: short-unlisted-fallback-abs
vectors.notes: unlisted SHORT: |net| in the fallback -- adverse regardless of sign; IM = 0.433*4e8 = 173200000.

vectors.name: realistic-4pair-k150
vectors.notes: dense 4-symbol book, K=150 m=2, deterministic pseudo-random returns with wei-level noise; seat floor non-binding.

vectors.name: custom-fallback-10pct
vectors.notes: FALLBACK_RET is a parameter: 10% here, not the 43.3% default; IM = 0.10*1e9 = 100000000.

vectors.name: exact-equal-at-cutoff
vectors.notes: K=200 m=2; 2nd and 3rd losses EXACTLY equal; index tie-break puts scenario 1 inside the tail, scenario 2 outside; IM value unaffected.
